newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HPL in S$170 mln bond, loan deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: HPL in S$170 mln bond, loan deal - paper.

text.p: Developer Hotel Properties Ltd (HPL) plans to raise about Singapore $170.0 million through a combination bond issue and transferable loan facility, the daily Straits Times said on Tuesday.
The bonds would be unsecured over five years at fixed rates and should raise about S$99.1 million, while the loan facility would raise S$69.7 million (US$49.6 million).

Re-financing was expected to account for about S$80.8 million of the bond proceeds and US$45.5 million of the loan facility. The balance of both would be added to HPL's working capital said the company.
OCBC Bank was appointed to manage the bond issue and arrange the loans, the report said.
HPL and OCBC officials had no immediate comment on the report.
